tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i las byang mdor bsdus pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bskyed rdzogs 'bring po gtso bor ston pa'i las byang ngag bsgrigs mdor bsdus pa dngos grub kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// rab brjid byu ru'i lhun po gang la mtshams sprin mdangs kyis 'khyud 'dra'i sku// mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar shes rab ral gri stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam 'dzin// sna tshogs dar dang rin po ches brgyan gzhon tshul rgyal ba kun gyi yab// 'jam mgon bla ma dus rnam kun tu bdag gi gtsug na gus pas bsten// gdod nas ka dag lhun gyis grub cing byed pos 'dus ma bgyid dbyings las// rang snang sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar mkhan zhi dang khro bo'i rnam rol gyis// srid gsum yid mkhar rtag par rol mdzad rgyal ba yab yum sras dang 'khor// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs la rnam kun gus pas phyag bgyi'o// 'dir bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs 'bring po gtso bor ston pa'i las byang shin tu bsdus pa nyams su blang ba la don gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro la bdun/ skyabs sems gtor ma bka' bsgo dang*// srung mtshams brda sgo brda phyag bya// bshags pa dam bca' byin dbab cing*// mchod pa byin rlabs dag dang bdun// spyi bdun dang po skyabs sems dang*// gtor ma bka' bsgo srung mtshams ni// 'di'i dbang lung thob cing lag len la mkhas pa'i sngags pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rten bshams pa'i mdun du/ sman raka/ gtor ma/ tshe gal/ mthun gsum la sogs pa lag len mthong brgyud ltar bshams la/ stan bde bar 'khod nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor phyi nang lha// mchog gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung la// byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/

sems bskyed ni/ ma gyur 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho chen gyi// sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrugs las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag gis sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor che// nyams su blangs nas byang chub mchog thob bgyi// lan gsum/ kyai/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can gshegs// gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul// nyes sgrib mthol bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// chos gsung phyir bskul bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs// dus gsum dge tshogs byang chub thob phyir bsngo// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ stong nyid ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// rang rig skad cig zhe sdang rdo rje'i sku// mthing nag zhal gsum nag dkar dmar zhing khro// g.yas gsum rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa gdengs// g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sgrog dril bu 'khrol// dur khrod chas gsol gnas gsum yi ges mtshan// 'od 'phros ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha// spyan drangs dbang bskur mi bskyod rgyas btab nas| |dbang lha ye shes sems dpa' bdag la thim// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsgom/ gtor ma gsum la chu chang bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par bsam/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/

lan gsum/ gtor ma dang po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ yul nyer bzhi/ gnas so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro phyogs skyong zhing skyong gi tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas 'dir sgrub pa chen po dbu nas mjug gi bar du nang gi dngos grub phyir ma gtong*| phyi'i bar chad nang du ma gtong*/ 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing phrin las thams cad 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig /gtor ma gnyis pa 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bdag po lha klu btsan bdud gza' skar sa bdag mthu stobs dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ khyad par sgrub gnas chen po 'di'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// rnal 'byor pa bdag cag sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa la ko long ru nga phrag dog gi bsam pa spongs la zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /ṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod rgyal spros/ bgegs thams cad gtor ma len pa'i slad du mdun du skad cig gis bkug |sarba bhū ta ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gtor ma gsum pa 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di bgegs rigs lan chags 'byung po rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang*/ sngags nyan pa dang*/ phyag rgyar blta ba la mi dbang ba thams cad la sbyin no// gtor ma 'di khyer la gnas 'dir ma 'dug par gzhan du song zhig /sarba bhū ta gats+tshaḥ zhes brjod/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐ */ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed// rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni// sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa// stobs chen khro bo chen po yis// klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos// de bas rang rang gnas su dengs// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇār+ṣa pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| ces drag sngags brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la gsum/ phyi nang gsang ba'o// dang po phyi'i srung 'khor thun mong ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid thugs srog 'od zer las// 'phros pa'i badz+ra tsakra bh+raṃ'u// gser gyi 'khor lo steng 'og dang*// phyogs mtshams rtsibs bcu g.yas su 'khor// de'i phyir rim bzhin gser gyi ni// 'khor lo rtsibs stong rdo rje dang*// rin chen pad+ma rgya gram dang*// dbyug to ral gri phur bu me// sdig sbrul stong pa sgra'i gur khang*// ā di kā di rang sgra sgrog /ces dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor mtshams kyi dgongs pa ni/ phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi ni rgyal chen bzhi la gnyer gtad sgrub chen ltar dang*/ gnyis pa nang gi srung mtshams la lnga las/ dang po 'bar ba lta stangs kyi mtshams ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid las kyi he ru kaḥ /rngam khro spyan gnyis nyi zla gsal// rdo rje'i 'gros skor sdang mig blta| |zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug sgra sgrog /spyan gyi 'od kyis dgra bgegs sreg /oṃ sūr+ya tsan+d+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las byung ba'i 'od kyis bgegs bsad gso'i las bgyi zhing rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dal bskor te sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa khro bo bcu'i mtshams ni/ hūm̐ṃ */ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas// 'dod rgyal dmar skya tho ba dang*// lcags kyu thogs pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ */ phyogs skyong bcu bkug phyogs bcu ru// pho mo gan rkyal kha sbug bsnol// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇār+ṣa pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ in+d+ra/ ag+ni/

ya ma/ nai ṛ t+ya/ wa ru ṇa/ wā ya we/ ku be ra/ i shā na/ sūr+ya/ tsan+d+ra/ pra ti bhe/ ti ra baṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'dod rgyal gyis phyogs skyong bcu gdan du bting bar bsam/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid thugs las 'bar ba'i hūm̐// bcu spros 'phro 'dus yongs gyur pa// steng du hūm̐ dkar shar rnam rgyal// lho ru gshin rje nub rta mgrin// byang du 'khyil pa mer dbyug sngon// srin por mi g.yo rlung 'dod rgyal// byang shar khams gsum 'og stobs chen// zhal gsum phyag drug sku stod ni// khro tshul mtshon thogs dur khrod chas// smad phur phyogs skyong snying la gzir// me klong sprul dang yang sprul spros// bar gcod gdon bgegs brlag cing sreg /oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a tsa la hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ bar gcod 'byung po gardza gardza/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa ham̐'u phaṭa/ ces phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying khar phur bu btab pas bde ba chen pos brgyal bar bsams la/ gsum pa sreg byed me'i mtshams ni/ hūm̐ */ ye nas rnam dag gzhal yas 'dir// mi dang mi min dgra bgegs rnams// bskrad kyang 'dug na bdag nyid kyi// thugs las ye shes lnga yi me// 'bar bas stong gsum phyogs bcur bkang*// 'ur chen rab 'bar tsha tsha 'phros// srid gsum bsreg na bgegs ci smos// oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ dam sri 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bdag gi thugs ka nas ye shes lnga'i me bskal pa'i me ltar spros pa'i klong chen po nas gdon bgegs thams cad kyi bag chags nyon mongs bsreg par bsam/

bzhi pa mtshon cha 'chol ba'i mtshams ni/ hūm̐ */ 'dir ni srung ma dam tshig can// 'du ba'i rigs rnams ma gtogs par// log 'dren gtor mas bskangs zin gyi// mi 'gro gnas na bdag nyid kyi// thugs las oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa e// dzaḥspros rdo rje 'khor lo dang*// phur bu tho ba ral gri'i tshogs// grangs med phyogs bcur spros pa yis// steng 'og bar snang phyogs mtshams kun// mtshon cha'i gur dang bla bre dang*/ ra ba dra ba sa gzhi sprin// thog ser char kun mtshon cha yi// 'du 'phro 'bar bas dgra bgegs brlag /oṃ badz+ra tsakra kī li kī la ya mud+ga ra ā ko ṭa ya tīk+ṣ+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas phyogs bcur mtshon chas gtams shing bar srubs kun mtshon cha'i thog ser dang me'i 'du 'phros gang bar bsam/ lnga pa khro bo rol pa'i mtshams ni/ hūm̐ */ stong gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun// khro bo rol pa'i lha yis gang*// kun kyang mi bzad gtum rngam khro// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun// khro bo khro mo khro chung gtams// ma mo mkha' 'gro sde brgyad tshogs| |pho nya las byed rol pa'i gar// sprin ltar skar mda' glog ltar rgyu// snang srid ye nas rgyal ba'i zhing*// bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med// de ltar rtogs na bgegs las grol| |oṃ lo ka sarba ma hā kro dha ya mān+ta ka ha ya grī ba pad+mān+ta kṛta karma kro dhī ma ma ru lu ru lu sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brtan g.yo thams cad khro bo khro mo'i rnam rol du bsam/ gsum pa gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyi mtshams ni/ hūm̐ */ ma bcos thig le lhun grub mtshams// 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus chos// sems nyid bde chen dag pa'i klong*// de ltar gsal rtogs bgegs zhes bya'i| |ming yang med pa mtshams kyi mchog /lhun grub dkyil 'khor ka nas dag /sa ma ya āḥ zhes chos thams cad blo bral gnyis med thig le nyag gcig rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du zla'o// spyi don gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni|

hūm̐ */ de ltar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus// mdun mkhar rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha// ye shes lnga klong rang rtsal mdangs// gdod nas grub pa rang gis gsal// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes lag gnyis bsnol ba'i mtheb mdzub kyis se gol dpung mgo gnyis su gtog /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa ga sa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ hoḥ brtan g.yo gdod nas rten brten pa// dkyil 'khor chen po dgu ru dag /bdag cag ma rig rtog sgrib kyis// dkyil 'khor sgo bcad don ma mjal// rang rig rang snang rang rtsal gyi// rang bzhin rtogs pa'i brda sgo dbye// tsak+ṣuḥmaṇ+ḍal pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ces brjod/ spyi don gsum pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hoḥ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// rang byung rang shar ye nas dag /rang rtsal rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor la// brda dang gar gyis rab mtshon nas// rnal 'byor spyod mchog phyag bgyi'o// a la la hoḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes rigs gsum gyi phyag bya/ spyi don bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bla ma rig 'dzin zhi khro bka' brgyad lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can bdag la dgongs// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul blo sku gsung thugs// lta sgom spyod pa rtsa ba yan lag gi// dam tshig gzhung bzhin ma spyad dang ma blang*// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul gyur pa ci mchis pa// ka dag gnas lugs ngang du gzung 'dzin chos// gnyis med mnyam pa chen por lhun grub kyang*// kun rdzob sgyu mar nongs nyes gang bgyis pa// rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags bgyid na// bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub ni// sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan bstsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ spro na ye shes sku mchog kyang bya'o// spyi don lnga pa dam bca' ba ni/ hoḥ khams gsum sems can ye sangs rgyas// log rtog dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams| |snying rje'i yul gyur bsgral ba'i phyir// sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha// gdod nas bdag dang gnyis su med// srog gi phyir yang mi gtang zhing*// rtse gcig gus pas bsgrub par bgyi'o// a la la hoḥ

sa ma ya bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ spyi don drug pa byin dbab pa ni/ spyar ba'i spos sreg rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing*/ hūm̐ */ dus gsum rgyal rnams chos sku skye med la// gzugs sku 'gro don mdzad phyir gnyis med kyi// dbyings dang skur bzhengs rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// dngos grub thob phyir lha dang rig 'dzin dang*// srung ma sprul 'khor bcas pa sprin gtibs ltar| |'dir gshegs dngos grub ma lus char bzhin phob// sku yi gar stabs glog 'khyug gsung gi sgra// 'brug ltar sgrog cing thugs brtses bdag la dgongs// dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas rnams la byin chen phob// gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*// dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bstsal du gsol// mthu rtsal nus phyung rtags mtshan myur du ston// thugs dam gnyen po'i dus bab dngos grub stsol// sa ma ya ā we sha ya aḥ spyi don bdun pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chu// spros pas mchod pa'i yo byad rnams// nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs shing dag /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ bi shud+dhe hūm̐/ phyi mchod ni/ stong nyid ngang las thod pa'i snod// a las dung chen yangs pa'i nang*// hūm̐ las mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// rang bzhin stong pa rnam pa rdzas// byed las zag med bde ba bskyed// 'dod yon mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha la 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad a dhiṣ+ṭhā na hūm̐ hoḥ sman byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yaṃ las rlung dang raṃ las me dkyil steng*// kaṃ las thod sgyed snod ni ka pā la/ /phyi dkar nang dmar yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba ru// zla lnga'i gdan la sha lnga na da go// ha kus mtshan zhing bdud rtsi rnam lnga la// mū ma bi ra shu las spros pa'i steng*// kha gcod āḥlas zla dkyil dbyangs gsal bkra// dbus su rgya gram khong gseng oṃ āḥhūm̐// gis mtshan hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod bdag nyid kyi// srog rtsol rlung bus rlung g.yos me sbar bas// snod dros rdzas zhu rlangs pa zla rdor la// phog pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing du 'phros// mchod cing bcud bsdus thod pa'i bdud rtsir thim// rgya gram lte bar hrīḥdang muṃ yig las// rta mgrin yab yum 'khril sbyor mdzad pa'i steng*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang swā hā las 'khor lo| |pad+ma rdo rje rin chen ral gri lnga// sa bon lngas mtshan yongs gyur rigs lnga'i sku// yab yum 'khril sbyor mkha' gsang nyi zla'i dbus// hūm̐ las che mchog yab yum 'khril shing sbyor// mtheb srin sbyar bas thod pa'i bdud rtsi steng du bzung la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhāḥ gsum brjod/ rdo rje'i sngags sgras lha rnams rab bskul bas// ma chags thabs kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe| |chags pa'i sgra 'od sangs rgyas zhing kun spros// mchod cing de rnams rjes chags kyis zhu bas// rigs lnga'i zhal zhugs byang sems bdud rtsir gyur// mkha' gsang las bab che mchog zhal du brgyud// de yi mkha' bab rta mgrin yab yum gyi// dbu gtsug bab pa sku yi dbyibs brgyud nas// mkha' gsang las thon thod pa'i bdud rtsir thim| |slar yang rigs lnga che mchog rta mgrin bcas// bdud rtsir zhu zhing zag med sman chen po// snod ni bde skyong bcud ni byang chub sems// gnas ni mkha' gsang bcud ni snyoms zhugs pas| |don ni skye med las ni rnam rtog sbyong*// ra sa yā na dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// zhes so/ rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dung chen rlon pa chos 'byung yum gyi mkha'// nyi ma'i gdan la rak+ta 'od du 'bar// gdug can nyon mongs chags pa dbang du bsdus// rak+tar thim zhing yab kyi gsang ba'i dbyibs// sna tshogs rdo rje'i tho bas rab brdung zhing*// mtshon cha'i char bab nyon mongs bag chags sbyangs// e pad+ma bha ga ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal la/ raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes lan gcig dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrī ṭhāḥ lan gsum/ hoḥ rgyu rkyen las byung rak+ta'i mtsho// rba klong 'khrugs shing mchog chen dang*// mchog phran lhu dum 'phyo zhing lding*// khrag lbu ri rab tsam du 'phur// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha la 'bul// gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni| hoḥ rlung me thod steng dung chen dkar la dmar// de nang sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// hūm̐ dang bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ bāṃ lāṃ māṃ// pāṃ tāṃ gyis mtshan 'od 'phros rlung me sbar// rdzas khol nyes sbyangs 'dod yon chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭhāḥ
